decisions.reason: Although the accelerator is less core than the firm's machinery business, it was put on the home page and linked to the established offer, so public commitment and a growing firm context make management likely to continue it for now.

This binder appears less central to the firm's machinery-based recycling direction and was marketed with lower visible commitment than the others, so escalation forces are weaker and management can more easily discontinue it if early results disappoint.

The infectious-waste plant is close to the established offer, was prominently launched on the home page with strong promotional language and partners, and therefore carries enough investment and public commitment to encourage persistence.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly aligned with the firm's core decentralized recycling strategy, was highlighted on the home page as the latest product, and is the kind of visibly backed machinery launch that management is especially likely to keep.
